capabilities: Distill writing style from a single note or multiple notes
Save distilled styles to a style library folder
Generate articles from a title, requirements, and an optional saved style
Store generated drafts in a designated output folder
disambiguation: Not a general AI writing assistant; it specifically extracts style from existing notes and rewrites in that style.
extras: Setup assumes a pre-built vault distributed by the author (with a 'Trust Author' step); the full usage guide is a note inside the vault rather than in the README, and the API key requires recharging an account on an external site.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to analyze the style of existing notes and produce new articles that match it.

requires.name: API key from the author's recharge site

summary: AI plugin that distills the writing style of reference notes and generates new articles in that style.
